[[Deportivo Saprissa|Saprissa]] | league topscorer = Álvaro Saborío Chacón (13 goals as of 15 December 2019) | biggest home win = Saprissa 6–0 Limon FC (21 October 2019) | biggest away win = Grecia 0–6 Saprissa (8 September 2019) | prevseason = [[2018–19 Liga FPD|2018–19]] | nextseason = [[2020–21 Liga FPD|2020–21]] }} The '''2019–20 [[Liga FPD]]''' season, also known as '''Liga Promérica'''{{Cite web|url=http://unafut.com/index.php/noticias/478-liga-promerica-sera-el-nuevo-concepto-del-futbol-de-la-primera-division|title=UNAFUT – SITIO OFICIAL – Liga Promerica será el nuevo concepto del fútbol de la primera división|website=unafut.com|access-date=16 December 2019|archive-date=11 September 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200911143103/http://unafut.com/index.php/noticias/478-liga-promerica-sera-el-nuevo-concepto-del-futbol-de-la-primera-division|url-status=dead}} for sponsorship reasons, is the 99th season since its establishment. The tournament is divided into two championships, the Apertura and Clausura, each in an identical format and each contested by 12 teams. The [[Voit]] Loxus is the official match ball of the tournament.{{Cite web|url=http://unafut.com/index.php/noticias/506-unafut-presento-el-calendario-de-la-liga-promerica-19-20|title=UNAFUT – SITIO OFICIAL – UNAFUT presentó el calendario de la Liga Promerica 19/20|website=unafut.com|access-date=16 December 2019}} San Carlos are the defending champions, after defeating Saprissa in the Clausura 2019 tournament. ==Teams and Structure Changes== A total of 12 teams will contest the league, including 11 sides from the [[2018–19 Liga FPD|2018–19 season]], one team promoted from the [[Segunda División de Costa Rica|Liga de Ascenso]]. [[A.D.R. Jicaral|Jicaral]] were promoted for the first time to the Liga FPD after defeating Guanacasteca in the Liga de Ascenso final, thus replacing [[A.D. Carmelita|Carmelita]] in the Liga FPD. Like the previous season, the league has the following playoff format. The top 4 teams in the regular season will progress to a two-legged knockout tournament. If the same team that wins the regular season wins the playoff, that team wins the season championship immediately.
